confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from a web search of RBA pages. It showed 0.6720 USD per AUD for 18 Nov 2026, though some cached pages showed older figures. Food and coffee anchors rest on one search of aggregated cost-of-living sources. Those sources vary widely and are mostly crowdsourced. Beer is based on those sources, but alcohol is scarce and pricey in Essaouira, and it is mostly served in licensed hotels and restaurants. Cocktail and wine prices are set from their usual relationship to beer, not from direct data. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, not from listings. July is peak season, so prices may run higher.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Essaouira price data, cross-checked against Marrakech and other Moroccan coastal tourist towns. Prices are slightly below the Marrakech level.
